Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly equated Łódź Film School (PWSFTviT/Łódź Film Academy) with the University of Łódź, stating “University of Łódź (a.k.a. Łódź Film School / Łódź Film Academy).” These are distinct institutions. Sources shown by WebSurfer (IMDb and Wikipedia) clearly indicate Jerzy Skolimowski studied at the University of Warsaw and the Łódź Film School, not the University of Łódź. This misinterpretation could lead to an incorrect final answer about where the director studied.
